race.comment: AUTUMN GLOW (8) outstanding mare who resumes. Had the first blemish of her career when third to Sir Delius in the G1 Queen Elizabeth Stakes over 2000m last April. Can tag the fast tempo with the two trials under the belt. The one to beat. SHEZA ALIBI (14) untapped mare who monstered her rivals when taking out the G1 Randwick Guineas and G1 Doncaster Hcp by big margins in the autumn. Looks primed with the two jump outs, the slight niggle is where she gets too from the rails draw. GRINGOTTS (2) tough old gelding who gets better with age, resuming. Finished runner up to AUTUMN GLOW in the G1 George Ryder last March. Has trialled exceptionally well and don't underestimate. CEOLWULF (1) failed to come up in two runs last prep and was immediately spelled. Look for him warming up late.
